name: backend-plugin
description: Evidence-led backend, VPS, application security, data protection, code quality, performance, and vulnerability intelligence workflows.

interface.longDescription: A local plugin with nine evidence-led workflows and a read-only MCP tool that checks exact public package versions against OSV. It reviews backend code, VPS configuration, application and browser security, databases, privacy, code quality, measured performance, and public vulnerability intelligence. The OSV tool sends public package coordinates to OSV and returns whitelisted advisory metadata. The plugin does not monitor continuously or operate live systems.
defaultPrompt: Review this backend project for security, privacy, database, and operational risks.
Find the measured CPU, memory, or database bottleneck and propose a safe optimization.
Check this project’s dependencies against current public vulnerability advisories if sources are available, and explain a safe fix.
